chapters.title: Chapter 901: I also thank you very much
paragraphs: Everyone talked a lot, although Chu Xiaobei also said that his progress was made by Su Lang alone, but everyone didn't believe it.
Indeed, Su Lang's methods are too abnormal, too unreasonable, and completely beyond people's imagination.
at this time.
Su Lang appeared in front of everyone.
Everyone gradually closed their mouths.
They are still very afraid of Su Lang!
"Hey!"
Chu Xiaobei smiled and ran to Su Lang with a happy expression.
suddenly.
"The villain thanked the lord for taking care of Beckham!"
The old woman Mi knelt and kowtowed to Su Lang, her expressions and words were very sincere.
Immediately afterwards, those warriors who were silent also knelt down and bowed to Xie Sulang.
There is less fear and more respect.
Some small children even worship Su Lang very much, thinking that being a martial artist should be so powerful and domineering.
"Everyone, please."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I heard Chu Xiaobei say that you did not take care of her less before, and I also thank you very much."
After that, he also took out some cherished medicines and rewarded them to Mi Lai, Lai Bang and others.
Almost everyone who had cheered around Chu Xiaobei received a reward.
Holding the pill given by Su Lang, they were directly stunned. They were sacred pill and quasi elixir of perfect quality.
What they didn't know was that if their cultivation level were not too low, Su Lang would have rewarded them with elixir.
at the same time.
Mi Laoyu and others also drew a conclusion from Su Lang's words and actions.
That is, this mysterious adult has regarded Chu Xiaobei as his own person, that is to say, the two are very close, as if they are one body, that is, the relationship between the Taoist couple!
"With such a powerful Taoist guardian, Chu Xiaobei's cultivation path will be much safer."
When everyone thought about it like this, they suddenly felt that Chu Xiaobei's hope of becoming Emperor was much greater.
At this time.
Xuan Ao had already brought some confidants and came to Su Lang's side, obviously ready to go.
"I'm about to set off to clean up the Six Dao Immortals."
"You wait and practice in Xuanyu Fairy City, and don't worry about me and Xiaobei."
Su Lang left a word to stop the old woman Mi and others from wanting to follow.
Immediately after.
He took Chu Xiaobei, Xuan Ao and others to Shanhe City.

As the front line of Xuanyu Fairy City, Shanhe City has no direct teleportation formation on the surface, in order to prevent the enemy from attacking the hinterland through the teleportation formation.
Of course, there is of course a secret teleportation array.
This is also the reason Xuanhan Wuxian can run back from the outside so quickly against Su Lang.
Through a teleportation array, Su Lang and his party arrived at a mountain stream 10,000 miles away from Shanhe City.
In the narrow mountain stream, there is a huge cave made of Conferred God Stone, which can block and deceive the exploration of the gods.
The cave can accommodate tens of thousands of people, and at the same time, it is also the place where the secret teleportation array is located.
The light flashed, and Su Lang led Chu Xiaobei, Xuan Ao and dozens of others out of the teleportation formation, and saw a group of remnants and defeated generals.
There are more than 10,000 of them, most of them are of the level of the of war, and there are only about 20 of them, and the leader is a quasi immortal.
But no matter how high or low the cultivation level is, all of them are covered in injuries, obviously undergoing a hard fight.
Presumably, they are the warriors of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan who collapsed in Shanhe City, condensing and repairing again here.
Too.
The opponent is so strong, a group of defeated generals can't escape far, they can only hide.

Moreover, this group of people did not escape back to Xuanyu Immortal City through the teleportation formation. They were obviously not reconciled, and wanted to wait for reinforcements and counterattack back.
This group of people, like Xuanyue, is a tribe with a ‘heart of seeking Tao’.
"Master Xuan Ao!"
A badly injured quasi immortal was crying and fell to his knees, "The villain lost the city of mountains and rivers, a capital crime, please be punished!"
"Yu Hu, the enemy is too strong. It's not a war, so excuse me!"
Xuan Ao waved his hand, and then quickly said, "Come and meet this Master Su and Chu Xiaobei!"
While talking, Xuan Ao also gave a demonstration and performed a very, very humble prayer to Su Lang.
When Yu Hu and the warriors under his command saw this scene, they were so surprised that their tongues were about to fall.

chapters.title: Chapter 902: Sad Mountain River City
paragraphs: "What is the identity of this lord, why does lord Xuan Ao kneel down and worship him?"
"Also, Chu Xiaobei, that is Chu Xiaobei, yes, I have seen the portrait, it is exactly the same! She is back!"
"The hope of Emperor Cheng, the hope of Emperor Cheng, why do you want to come back, why do you have to take risks yourself, come to this most dangerous place!?"
"Chu Xiaobei, there are unknown mysterious men, what are they doing here!?"
Everyone had different thoughts, but there was no negligence in the etiquette, and immediately followed Xuan Ao and bowed down to Su Lang.
"Get up, it's important to heal your injuries!"
"Take these pills and heal your injuries quickly. We will soon counterattack the Six Dao Immortals and retake Shanhe City!"
Su Lang asked everyone to get up, and gave a lot of the best healing pills.
"God, this is a quasi elixir!"
"Not only is the elixir of high grade, it is also a perfect quality pill!"
"What on earth does this mysterious lord come from? He can give so many cherished pills at his fingertips, just like spilling a handful of beans!"
Stormy waves rose in the hearts of everyone, only to feel that Su Lang's figure became taller and magnificent, and was shrouded in a layer of mist, unpredictable.
Immediately after.
Everyone took the pill, and the medicine was almost cured. The wounds healed quickly, and they couldn't help but rejoice.
"How is the situation in Shanhe City now?"
Su Lang looked at everyone and asked aloud.
"Yu Hu, come on."
Xuan Ao nodded to Yu Hu.
The battlefield situation is changing rapidly. Although he left Shanhe City and returned to Xuanyu Fairy City in a short time, no one can say whether Shanhe City has any new changes.
"Return your lord!"

Yu Hu was signaled by Xuan Ao and saluted Su Lang, "After Master Xuan Ao and Master Xuan Han left, the news was revealed, and the Six Dao Xian Clan attacked Shanhe City under the leadership of two Wuxians.
Shanhe City fell in an instant, and we were scattered everywhere. We were chased and killed by the six immortals. During the period, the enemy was chasing after us.
We tried to kill the spies before we got rid of the enemy and gathered here.
However, there are still surveillance methods of our Xuanyu Fairy Clan in Shanhe City.
Then, we witnessed the scene of the six immortal clan massacre!
In Mountain River City, all members of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, as long as they were not from the Six Dao Immortal Clan, were killed.
A city with mountains and rivers, even if it was reduced to a frontline battlefield, and many people moved away, there were still millions of people!
But now, those millions of people have all been killed, all dead!
The blood flowed into small rivers and gathered into big lakes, flooding the entire mountain and river city!
The corpses were piled on the ground, forming a mountain in the city!
The city with beautiful mountains and rivers has become a city with corpses as mountains and blood as rivers! "
At this point, Yu Hu was already in tears.
But he didn't stop, wiped a tear, and continued: "We also discovered that after the fall of Shanhe City, another mysterious Seven Tribulations Wuxian came.
He discovered the surveillance methods we left behind and destroyed them. We are now blind and have no ability to spy on the outside world.
Yu Hu's voice echoed in the silent cave.
One by one the defeated warriors gritted their teeth and bowed their heads, their eyes split.
With just a few words, Su Lang could feel the blood and horror of the massacre scene.
And the tyrannical, fierce and vicious faces of the Six Dao Immortals.
Su Lang took a deep breath. He killed a hundred thousand people himself, already thinking that he was cruel, but the Six Dao Immortals were truly cruel.
Millions of people were killed directly!
"Six Dao Immortals are as cruel."
"Since you are unkind, don't blame me for being unrighteous."
Su Lang's eyes flickered with cold light, sweeping across the crowd, "After a quarter of an hour, let's go. I want the people of the Six Dao Immortals to know what cruelty is!"
This statement came out.
The crowd was thunderous, their faces unbelievable.
Except for Xuan Ao, they didn't know the true identity of Su Lang, and only thought that he was a powerful martial immortal from the clan who invited him to help.
But in Shanhe City now, there are two Wuxians from the Six Dao Immortal Clan, and one mysterious Seven Tribulations.
Can only rely on them, the defeated generals, the Three Tribulations Martial Immortal Xuan Ao, and this mysterious lord, can counterattack Shanhe City?
This is impossible!
Unless, unless this mysterious adult is a powerful Martial Immortal of the Eight Tribulations, then he can counterattack.
but.
Everyone couldn't help taking a look at Su Lang, and found that he didn't look like the Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 903: Ridiculous, extremely ridiculous
paragraphs: "My lord...just those of us, go to attack Shanhe City?"
Yu Hu rubbed his eyes and asked in disbelief.
"Hahahaha."
Su Lang laughed loudly, "To be precise, I went to attack Shanhe City by myself, so you should call Six Six Six."
"What is Six Six Six?"
Everyone looked dumbfounded, only Chu Xiaobei covered her mouth and chuckled. She knew about the ancient culture of the blue star of ‘Sixty Six’.
"You just go to witness, Master Su will take care of everything!"
Xuan Ao Wuxian on the side solemnly said to everyone.
Seeing that their old bosses were so serious, the ideas of Yu Hu and others were immediately reversed.
"It seems that this mysterious lord is really a martial immortal of the Eight Tribulations, or even a more powerful martial immortal!"
"With the help of this Wuxian, we will be able to recapture Shanhe City. At this time, there are only six immortal people in Shanhe City, so we will kill them all!"
Everyone's eyes lit up, and everyone was excited.
As the defeated generals, they all took a breath, and they were about to spit out smoothly at this time, wouldn't they be excited?
"If you have no doubts, let's go!"
Seeing everyone rising to war, Su Lang smiled happily.
Next.
Leading by Xuan Ao and Yu Hu, Su Lang and his party flew out of the cave and headed for Shanhe City.
The crowd was large in number, and the momentum was not small, and soon attracted the attention of the Liudao Xianzu warriors.
First, a group of Six Dao Xian tribes who were searching for Yu Hu and others discovered the escape of Su Lang and his group.
"A lot of people, they all seem to be from the Xuanyu Immortal Clan!"
"There are at least tens of thousands of people, which is exactly the same as the number of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan who fled before!"
"I couldn't wait to find them, but at this time they ran out of their own accord. It really didn't take much effort to break through the iron shoes and find nowhere to look!"
"Quickly, send a message back to the city, telling Master Liuming that the little cubs of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan ran back to look for death!"
One by one, the excited Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors took out the jade card for communication and sent it to their boss.
Immediately after.
They also flew towards Shanhe City.
But before they could fly far, a terrifying mental power suddenly descended.
It turned out that Su Lang used a mental attack!
The terrifying mental power attack launched by the Wuxian's Sunshine Realm was simply not something those Wushengs could resist.
In just a moment, all the Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors within the range of Xuan Ao's spiritual power were all dead.
With this move alone, there were more than a dozen martial sages, and thousands of martial sages died in Su Lang's hands.
The Soul of Wusheng, the Soul of Valkyrie, the guide of space, and various materials suddenly entered Su Lang's storage space.
Xuan Ao originally wanted to do it, but seeing Su Lang did it, he held back.
at the same time.
Mountain River City.
The three Wuxians were sitting in the sky, holding a beautiful woman Wusheng, while admiring the blood-colored mountains and rivers at their feet, drinking small wine, wanton debauchery, so happy.
Two of them are the Liuming and Liuchang Wuxians of the Liudaoxian clan, both of them look like old men with the bones of immortal wind.
The two of them guarded a middle-aged man, who was the Wuxian of Seven Tribulations in the mouth of a tiger.
The Seven Tribulations Wuxian was named Jieming Wuxian, and he was a member of the hidden force under the Luoyou emperor clan, who specialized in dirty work.
Just when the three of them were eating, drinking and having fun.
The news that the Xuanyu fairy clan warrior had fled and returned reached their ears, causing a burst of laughter.
The female saints also agreed and laughed. For a while, the sky over Shanhe City was full of smiles.
"Hahahaha!"
"It's ridiculous, extremely ridiculous!"
Liuming Wuxian was full of sarcasm, "I never thought that the warriors of the Xuanyuxian clan would actually do stupid things like moths fighting the fire!"
"Yes."
Wuxian Liuchang shook his head contemptuously, "I originally planned to let them live for a while, but I didn't expect that, haha, I sent it to the door by myself!"
"Perhaps, did they come prepared?"
"Let me see what they are here!"
Jie Ming Wuxian smiled playfully, and thought in his heart: I'm afraid that Xuan Yue, the clan chief Xuan Yu, will be off in person. If this is the case, I will be very lucky.

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Did it come to surrender?
paragraphs: However, when Jie Ming Wuxian unfolded his mental power and saw the incoming person clearly, he was disappointed.
Because the people who came were only the defeated group of soldiers before!

In addition to these people, there is also a Three Tribulations Martial Immortal Xuan Ao, and there is also a young martial artist who seems to be at the quasi immortal level, but whose actual combat power is a little weird.
"There is also a female quasi fairy!"
"This woman is...Chu Xiaobei!"
Jie Ming Wuxian was taken aback for a moment, and then he showed ecstasy!
Liuming Wuxian and Liuchang Wuxian saw that Jieming Wuxian was so surprised, they couldn't help their expressions, and they started to look at them.
At this time Su Lang and others were very close to Shanhe City.
Wuxian Liuming and Wuxian Liuchang noticed Chu Xiaobei instantly!
"It's Chu Xiaobei!"
"Chu Xiaobei, the emperor of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan!"
"Didn't she escape? Why is she here!?"
Liuming Wuxian muttered, his face mixed with surprise and surprise.
"Their group did not have the strength to fight us, but they went and returned."
Wuxian Liuchang thought with his face: "Moreover, I also brought Chu Xiaobei with him. Could it be that he came to surrender!"
"It should be like this!"
"Xuanyu Immortal Clan has long been unable to withstand the pressure we exerted."
The surprise on Wuxian Liuming’s face gradually disappeared, “surrendering at this time and offering Chu Xiaobei is their only choice for the whole world.”
"But there is something wrong!
"They came to surrender, why kill the warriors we sent out to hunt them!?"
Liuchang Wuxian frowned, "That's not less than a dozen martial sages and thousands of martial gods."
"huh huh huh huh!"
"In my opinion, they just want to mention conditions and strive for some benefits, so they pretend to be tough."
Jie Ming Wuxian sneered on the side, a look of contempt that had already seen everything.
"Haha, Master Jieming can see it clearly!"
"This group of remnants must have such thoughts!"
Liuming Wuxian sneered, "But they think that pretending to be tough can cover up their weakness and weakness?"
"Hehe."
"This group of people are already on the fish, we are knives, we can cut how we want."
Wuxian Liuchang was also full of disdain, "It's ridiculous to pretend to be tough, hahahaha."
"Stop talking for now."
"Go, we will meet these fish and meat, and then think about them."
Jie Ming Wuxian waved his big hand, and didn't let go of the female saint in his arms, so he hugged the female saint and flew towards Su Lang and the others.
Liuming Wuxian and Liuchang Wuxian followed suit, holding a woman and closely behind Wuxian Jieming.
Behind them, a whole hundred more martial sages rose into the sky and followed.

When these martial sages heard the discussion of the three martial immortals, they naturally thought that Su Lang and others had come to surrender, and all of them looked relaxed, with a hint of sarcasm.
Not long.
The three martial gods of Jieming, Liuming, and Liuchang, and a hundred or so Wushengs stood on the edge of the mountain river city.

Cut off Emperor Wu's head to kick the ball?
How arrogant and bold this is!
"Hehe, isn't he just a Wudi?"
"What's wrong with Emperor Wu, Emperor Wu can't kill him?
A joke!"
Su Lang shook his head contemptuously, "Stop talking nonsense with you, now, answer my question."
"What...what's the problem?"
Liuming Wuxian tremblingly asked.
In his opinion, if Su Lang offended Emperor Luo Youwu, he would definitely end up miserably, but no matter how miserable it is, it will be afterwards.
The top priority now is to save lives!
And Su Lang wants to ask them questions, and this may contain the hope of survival!
"Who is the chicken egg, who is the rock?"
"Who is the praying mantis and who is the chariot?"
Su Lang looked around at the crowd and asked faintly, "Who is the fish, and who is the sword?"
"I, I am a chicken egg!
I am a mantis, I am a fish!"
"Master Su is a rock, Master Su is a chariot, Master Su is a sword!"
"When I offend Master Su, I don't know how to live or die, and I beg Master Su for mercy and go around us!"
Wuxian Liuchang hurriedly answered Su Lang's question, and begged for mercy by the way.
Jie Ming Wuxian said before that those who arbitrarily surrendered were dead, but at this time even the Wuxian of the Six Dao Immortal Clan begged for mercy, and his face was suddenly blue and red.
"Hahahaha!"
Su Lang got the answer from Liuchang Wuxian and couldn't help but laugh up to the sky.
"Haha, haha, ahaha!
Wuxian Liuchang agreed and laughed, and Wuxian Liuming and others also laughed, their faces full of flattering.
Xuan Ao and the others also thought about whether to agree with Master Su Lang and laugh together.
But at this moment.
Su Lang suddenly looked cold: "You dare to call me a stone, a car, a kitchen knife, and you think you got the answer right.
It's ridiculous."
"what!?"
The laughter of Wuxian Liuchang and others stopped abruptly, their faces full of daze.
If you don't answer that way, how should you answer?
Liuchang Wuxian was not stupid, so he immediately changed his mind and said, "Master Su is as high as the sky and as wide as the earth.
You should compare it to the universe of the sun and the moon..."
"The answer was not satisfactory."
Su Lang smiled non-committal.
Seeing this, Wuxian Liuchang immediately strengthened his skills and slapped Su Lang's flattery.
Unexpectedly.
"No matter how good the answer is, it's no use."
Su Lang was full of playfulness, "I just want to see how respectful you are, and play with you.
Now, you can go and die."
As soon as the voice fell, the power of the rules fell on Liuchang Wuxian.
"no no!"
"Master Su, don't kill me!"
"I am willing to serve as a slave, and give everything, ah, no!"
Wuxian Liuchang screamed, and then found that he was not dead, he couldn't help but feel happy.
But then, the intense pain made him want to die!
Especially when the soul was tortured by the rules of spirit, yin and yang, Liuchang Wuxian almost wished that he was never born.

chapters.title: Chapter 908: Haha, as you wish
paragraphs: In the field.
Su Lang tortured Liuchang Wuxian in full view.
Including Liuming Wuxian, the warriors of the Liudaoxian tribe were trembling with fright and stood upside down.
Even Jieming Wuxian is like falling into an ice cave, cold all over.
Because he suddenly discovered that Su Lang not only mastered the rules of space, but also mastered the mysterious rules of the five elements, life and death, yin and yang, and spirit.
Let alone the quasi immortal, even the quasi emperor is unlikely to master so many mysterious special rules at the same time!
"This person keeps saying that he wants to kill Emperor Wu."
"It can display so many rules."
"Could it be...could it be that he is not a martial emperor!!"
Thinking of this, Jie Ming Wuxian's line of defense suddenly collapsed!
He felt unprecedented fear and despair. He began to tremble and began to want to ask for mercy.
And at this moment.
Su Lang walked in front of Wuxian Liuming.
"Big...sir!"
Liuming Wuxian plopped and knelt in front of Su Lang, but could not speak.
"I also ask you a question."
Su Lang raised his mouth slightly and asked with a smile, "Do you know how the dead word is written?"
How is the dead word written?
This question is exactly what Liuming Wuxian said when he mocked Su Lang and others.
"I, I know!"
"It's written this way, it's written this way!"
Wuxian Liuming hurriedly carved out the word'death' on the ground with trembling fingers.
He first deliberately wrote the words of the Xuanyuxian clan, and then wrote the words of the great emperors.
Finally, he wrote all the dead words he knew, and thousands of different dead words were written on the ground.
It can be seen that Liuming Wuxian's desire to survive is very strong.
but.
"Hahahaha."
"Sorry, you are all wrong."
"Dead words, that's how it is written!"
Su Lang showed a playful and icy smile, and pointed at Wuxian Liuming.
next moment.
"what--!!"
Liuming Wuxian screamed and fell softly to the ground.
Countless rules of power were also shrouded in his body, and the intense pain made him doubt life.
At the same time, he also understood that his tragic end was the word'death' in Su Lang's mouth!
"It's your turn."
Su Lang came to Jieming Wuxian with a deep sneer on his face.
"If you want to kill, you have to pluck, just listen to it!"
Jie Ming Wuxian's legs were weak, and in the weakest tone, he said this very hard sentence.
He could see that Liu Ming and Liu Chang Wuxian suffered more than just ordinary punishments!
He just imagined the pain that went deep into his soul, and he couldn't help shaking.
"Haha, as you wish."
Su Lang shrugged his shoulders with a smile, and immediately displayed a lot of power of rules, and began to torment Jie Ming Wuxian!
"Ah!"
Jie Ming Wuxian screamed soaring to the sky, scaring the animals and beasts tens of thousands of miles away from Shanhe City to tremble.
In the city, the warriors of the Six Dao Immortal Clan looked at the three martial immortals who had been punished, all of them looked blank and their brains were blank.
That's a superior Wuxian who dominates countless creatures.
But at this time they are like weak ordinary old men, unable to fight back, they are tortured with tears and feces!
Immediately after.
Su Lang's gaze fell on these Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors again.
He had said before, to slaughter the warriors of these six immortal races!
"You can't go to death easily."
"Then let you become a hot oil fire for cooking Zhiji Ming, Liuming and Liuchang!"
Su Lang looked indifferent, and his words were like a cold wind blowing in the abyss.
next moment.
The hundreds of martial sages, including the city head, and the tens of thousands of elites of the Six Dao Immortal Races in the city, were all wrapped up by the power of Su Lang's rules.

In addition to the power of various torturing rules, there are also rules of life that extract their breath of life to make up for the three of Jieming, Liuming and Liuchang, so that these three will not easily die.
Suddenly.
The whole mountain and river city was full of screams of despair.
This scene made the warriors of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan look very happy!
The three old Wuxian men are the chief culprits who have slaughtered millions of people in Shanhe City!
Those tens of thousands of warriors slaughtered Shanhe City's minions and weapons!
At this moment, they finally got the severe punishment they deserved!
"Okay, great!"
"Hahahaha, just can't let them die too happy!"
"The Xuanyu people who died in Shanhe City, have you seen it? The murderer who killed you has been punished!"
"It was Master Su who avenged us. I should pay tribute to Master Su, and remember this grace forever!"
One by one, the warriors of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan bowed down to Su Lang and kept kowtow.
"Get up all."
"This is just the beginning!"
Su Lang looked at the direction of the Six Dao Immortal Clan, with a charming smile at the corner of his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 909: A gift for the next city
paragraphs: Time passed quickly.
Soon, the ordinary warriors of the Six Dao Immortal Clan were drained of their breath and fell to the ground one by one.
But the three of Jieming Wuxian, Liuming Wuxian and Liuchang Wuxian are still alive and well, screaming Jiang Tianchang!
The whole mountain and river city was about to be shaken by the cry of these three Wuxians!
This short time.
The pain they tasted is more and deeper than all the pain in their millions of years of life combined!
Su Lang did not have the idea of slaughtering them directly.
Just like this, accompanied the martial artists of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, quietly watching the three sinful martial arts howling.
At the same time, watching them scream, it is estimated that there are still millions of Shanhe City residents who were massacred.
Over time.
Ji Ming Wuxian and the other three were not able to get supplemented by the breath of life. Under the power of Su Lang's rules, their injuries gradually worsened, and their crying became weaker.
I don't know what moment it is.
Wuxian Liuchang, the weakest, burped first.
Immediately there is Liuming Wuxian, followed by Jieming Wuxian.
System prompts came one after another, which meant that these three people were completely dead, without any suspicion of escape and hope of resurrection.
Looking at the dead Wuxian and warriors of the Six Dao Immortal Clan.
Xuan'ao Wuxian and other Xuanyuxian warriors are sad and happy.
I am pleased that the culprit has been put down, and the Six Dao Immortal Clan has also lost two powerful martial immortals, which is regarded as a serious injury.
The sad thing is that people are already dead, and the Xuanyu people who died in Shanhe City can no longer survive.
"Xuan Ao."
Su Lang faintly called.
"Master Su!"
Xuan Ao quickly ran to Su Lang's face.
"You left some people to bury the warriors of Shanhe City."
"The corpses of the Six Dao Xian Clan warriors, all beheaded, and the heads are handed over to me."
"Next, we are going to recover all the cities that were captured by the Six Dao Immortal Clan, and in turn capture all their territories!"
Su Lang gave the order in a relaxed tone, as if what he said was just a trivial matter.
"Yes, my lord!"
Xuan Ao Wuxian took the lead.
Then immediately led thousands of Xuan Yuxian martial artists to execute Su Lang's orders.
Su Lang accompanied Chu Xiaobei to talk.
Not long.
Xuan Ao Wuxian and the others took care of everything.
I have to say that the efficiency of the warrior is really too fast.
"Are all the heads in here?"
Su Lang took the ring that Wuxian Xuan'ao handed over, and took a look. It was filled with the hideous heads of the Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors, tens of thousands.
And these people are all pioneer warriors of the Six Dao Immortal Clan, all of them are elites, at least at the level of the of war.
"This is the gift I want to give to the next city."

"It is given to the city that originally belonged to the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, to comfort the warriors of the Xuanyu Xian Clan who died in battle, and also to the Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors who guarded the city."
Su Lang whispered, and immediately waved his big hand, leading Chu Xiaobei, Xuan Ao Wuxian and others to the next city.
Shanhe City only left a part of the Valkyrie, responsible for cleaning up the city and other chores.
Anyway, there is a formation left by Su Lang, so there is no need to worry about their safety.
The team of Su Lang and others shrank to thousands.
After obtaining the space coordinates of the next city from Wuxian Xuan'ao, Su Lang directly used the space rules to send everyone there.
Xuan Ao and others admired this trick.
A city named Xuanzhou appeared in front of Su Lang and the others.
The warriors of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan in this city were not slaughtered, but those who had not had time to escape were all turned into slaves and received inhuman treatment.
Many men of the Xuanyuxian tribe were casted and used control methods to make them worse off than pigs and dogs.
Women are even more miserable...
Seeing this scene through the formation, Su Lang did not hesitate at all and chose to do it directly.
"dark!"
With a thought, dark rules shrouded.
The entire Profound Ark City suddenly changed colors, turning dark and invisible!
The warriors in the city were shocked and panicked.
But those warriors of the Xuanyu immortal clan who had suffered so quickly came back to their senses with surprises on their faces.

paragraphs: "Dare to ask what is this fellow Daoist's name? What is the origin?"
Wu Xian said with an indifferent expression, he looked down on Su Lang, but he was a little afraid of the unknown forces behind Su Lang.
"Ha ha."
"My name, you are not qualified to know."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, "I want to know, what is the name of your groundhog?"
"Groundhog?"

"Just forget it."

at the same time.

The whole world turned yellow in an instant, as if it came to the bottom of the earth and was about to be squeezed into a ball by the majestic pressure!

-Devouring the clone!
For an instant.
Su Lang swallowed twelve clones.
"Boom!"

First, the breath of the Wuxian level of the Six Tribulations, and then the Seven Tribulations, the Eight Tribulations, and the Nine Tribulations did not stop.
Laya Wuxian and others dismissed it first.
However, when the breath of Su Lang Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal came out, everyone was stunned!
The whole mountain-winding city is silent!
"He turned out to be the Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal!"
"How come, how can I hide so deep!"
"This fellow is too insidious, the dignified Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal, even disguised as the Five Tribulations Martial Immortal!"
A turbulent wave rose in the heart of Wu Xian Xia Ya, and without hesitation, immediately fled to the city.
From here to the city, for Wuxian, it is estimated that less than one millisecond will be spent.
Xianya Wuxian also deeply believed that he could escape into the city.
Including the Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal who was dormant in the city, he was not worried that Martial Immortal Leya would not be able to escape.
Therefore, he did not do anything for the time being.
But they were all wrong.
"Space imprisoned!"
At the moment of Su Lang's thoughts, Wuxian Leya's figure directly solidified, and he could no longer move, even with a trace of panic on his face.
With Su Lang's own strength, it is impossible to confine the Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal with the rules of space.
But now he has the power of the Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal, isn't it easy to imprison a Tribulation Immortal?
At this moment.
Everyone in Tangshan City was stunned.
"Empty...space rules!?"
Wuxian Liupi and others opened their mouths in disbelief!
The Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal also looked astonished: "No, Martial Immortal Leya is in danger!"
Even think about it.
The Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal who was dormant in the dark started instantly.
I saw a pure dark rule emerge, to erode the space rule that Su Lang used.
"Want to save people? It's too late!"
Su Lang curled his mouth in disdain, and immediately hooked his finger, the terrifying space force squeezed fiercely, and the Martial Immortal Cliff immediately exploded!
This groundhog-like Wuxian Xiaya usually likes to use the rules of the earth to crush others, but now it is his turn to be crushed!
"Dead...dead!!"
"Xiao Ya Wuxian is dead, my God!"
"Master Lian Qu failed to save it personally!"
In Winding Mountain City, Liupi Wuxian was dumbfounded, and the brains of the others were blank.
"Damn, dare to kill my subordinates!"
"No matter who you are, I will kill you!"
Luo Quwu's fairy eyes are about to split, and at the same time he feels a little bit ashamed.
He is a genius of the Luoyou Emperor Clan, and has always been invincible at the same level.
But now, he suffered a loss on an unknown Martial Immortal of the same level, and lost an Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal for nothing!

At this time.
Su Lang's faint ridicule came: "The people who hide their heads and show their tails, aren't they coming out?"

paragraphs: "Since you want to die so much, I will fulfill you!"
"Do you think that if you control the rules of space, you are invincible at the same level?"
"Today, I will let you see what is truly invincible to the Nine Tribulations!"
Wuxian Luoqu rushed out of the mountain-winding city formation in an instant, and his cold eyes fixed on Su Lang.
"Ha ha!"
"Do you think you can sweep the Nine Tribulations? A joke!"
"What's more, what's so great about the power that is invincible to the Nine Tribulations?"

Facing the menacing Luoqu Wuxian, Su Lang showed a playful expression, "You are a trash, you are also attached to the same level. You have never thought about killing the enemy by jumping above the level. Are you embarrassed to pretend to be forced?"
"Kill the enemy leapfrog!?"
Wuxian Luoqu sneered, "It's really arrogant!"
In his opinion, this kind of thing may still happen in low-level warriors.
But at the Wuxian level, every small realm is a moat, and it is almost impossible to leapfrog the enemy!
"Arrogant?"
"You are too rubbish."
Su Lang shook his head disdainfully, and immediately hooked his finger at Luoqu Wuxian, "Hurry up and die, I don't want to talk to you rubbish."
"you wanna die!!"
As a well-known genius of the Luoyou emperor clan, after being humiliated by Su Lang many times, the anger in Luoqu Wuxian's heart erupted like a volcano!
With a wave of his hands, the endless dark rules enveloped the world, turning into an endless black huge mouth, swallowing towards Su Lang!
That terrifying breath suppressed millions of miles away, and even the birds and beasts thousands of miles away fled in panic!
"The dark rules are good.
Su Lang smiled non-committal, "Unfortunately, it's just that."
Facing Luoqu Wuxian's full blow, Su Lang didn't even move his finger.
The mouth that seemed to have replaced the sky swallowed, but it automatically stopped at a height of a kilometer above Su Lang's head.
The mouth is constantly twisting and struggling, quite terrifying!
Luo Qu Wuxian was shocked to see this.
"He actually mastered the dark rules!"
"Furthermore, and my attainments are not worse than mine, even higher!"
When Luoqu Wuxian was horrified, he used the strength of the milk to fight with Su Lang for the control of the dark rules.
however.
Even if he tried his best, the dark rules would not move, and he could no longer act like an arm.
Luo Qu Wuxian immediately panicked.
The dark rule is his strongest method.
But now, the best aspect has been restrained, which makes him both shameful and powerless.
"Damn it."
"You can only use that thing!"
After realizing that his own strength could not defeat Su Lang, Luo Qu Wuxian did not insist on using his own strength to fight Su Lang.
He took out something from his inner martial arts world.
It is a black skull.
Two mung bean-like flames were burning in the skull's eyes.
"Quasi Emperor Soldier?"
"No, it's a half-puppet, half-weapon refined with the head of the Emperor Zhun!"
Su Lang saw the origin of the black skull at a glance, and showed a disdainful smile.
This black skull refines the head of a quasi-emperor into a half-puppet and half-weapon in a very special way. Although it looks like a quasi-emperor, it is actually far inferior.
In short, this black skull is something stronger than the Nine Tribulations Immortal Tool.
Just when Su Lang was looking at the black skull.
Luoqu Wuxian has urged it!
I saw that the black skull head came back to life, issuing a terrifying roar.
A layer of green streamer flowed from the flames of its eyes, covering the surface, forming an emerald green head.
Not only that.
There are more green lights hanging down like flowing water, gradually framing the body and limbs under the head!
Suddenly.
A green humanoid creature appeared in front of Su Lang.
Its body exudes a faint quasi-emperor aura, just standing there, it is like a mountain that suppresses the world.
"Quasi emperor class!"
"Hahaha, I didn't expect Master Luoqu to have such a powerful hole card!"
"As soon as this quasi-emperor-level puppet appears, that arrogant Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal will definitely retreat!"
"No! Not only will he retreat, he will also be beheaded on the spot by Lord Luoqu, in order to avenge Wuxian Xia Ya!"

chapters.title: Chapter 915: You never have a chance
paragraphs: Surrounded by mountains in the city.
Wuxian Liupi and others talked, their faces full of excitement and excitement.
They were terrified by Su Lang before, and now they seem to see the end of Su Lang being killed, how can they not be happy?
at the same time.
Su Lang looked at the quasi-emperor-level puppet in front of him, somewhat startled.
"Tsk tsk."
"This quasi emperor is really sad enough!"
"Not only was he killed, but he was also made green. This is not a tragic word."
Su Lang shook his head sympathetically, "But if you meet me, you are considered lucky, and I will free you."
As Su Lang whispered.
The green puppet was already in Luoqu Wuxian's hideous look of resentment, and slayed at Su Lang.
It carries the terrifying "rule of poison" all over it.
Wherever it passed, the vegetation instantly turned into poisonous water, and even the ground turned into a green swamp in an instant, like festering skin.
Even the space has been corroded, revealing the grid of space faintly!
Su Lang stood in place, he only needed to swallow three more clones to reach the Quasi-Emperor level, easily pinching this green puppet to death.
But he didn't do that.
"The sword is coming!"
Su Lang whispered, but instead of calling the Youtian Sword, he called the Slaughter Sky Sword Sheath.
I saw a semi-imaginary white small sword flying out of the Slaughter Sky Sword Sheath, and it didn't fall into Su Lang's hand, just pierced straight at the green puppet.
The white little sword exudes a frightening breath, as if it can penetrate everything.
Luo Qu Wuxian, who was originally murderous and grim-faced, opened his eyes when he saw the white little sword.
"Quasi Emperor Sword Qi!"
"Moreover, it is a powerful sword spirit far surpassing the general quasi emperor!"
"That scabbard, capable of displaying such a powerful sword aura, must be a quasi-imperial soldier!"
"That Goblin also has quasi-imperial soldiers, and they are stronger than mine. When it's over, I'm not his opponent at all!"
Wuxian Luoqu felt that the scabbard was a bit familiar, but after a few thoughts flashed, he couldn't recall where he had heard it.
His only idea at this time is to escape!
The decisive Luoqu Wuxian immediately abandoned the green puppet, cast the secret technique of escape on the spot, and turned and fled away.

He also knew that Su Lang had mastered the rules of space, and he didn't dare to use teleportation methods at all. He only used the power of the rules of the whole body to protect himself from escape.
Just in the next moment.
The quasi-emperor-level sword aura of Slaughter Sky's scabbard violently hit the violent green puppet.
"Boom!"
An earth-shattering explosion sounded.
The green puppet exploded directly, and countless rules of poison splashed everywhere, and the whole world seemed to turn into an abscess!
Su Lang couldn't bear the suffering of this land, waved his hand, and used the rules of space to imprison these scattered poisonous rules.
Then they used the rules of thunder, fire, light, and yang to wrap it up, and gradually wear off.
This scene happened in an instant, the Liupi Wuxian and others in the city were still smiling, but their smiles were already stiff.

Everyone in the Six Dao Immortal Clan couldn't imagine that the quasi-emperor-level puppets would be wiped out all at once, and the powerful Luoqu Wuxian did not even think about it, and fled in embarrassment!
This unexpected change directly makes them dumbfounded and their brains are blank.
at the same time.
Su Lang looked into the distance and let out a chuckle: "Even Li Feilou and Xiao Lutian can't escape from my palm. A Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal, also wants to escape under my nose?"
next moment.
A clone was dispatched by Su Lang.
In the distance, Wuxian Luo Qu, who fled with twelve points of strength, breathed a sigh of relief.
"It seems that although I lost the quasi-emperor puppet, I also stopped the mysterious Wuxian."
"With the horrible poisonous rules of the quasi-emperor puppet, you must use the rules of thunder, fire, and yang to extinguish it."
"That mysterious Wuxian possesses a quasi-emperor-level sword energy, but it is absolutely impossible to master so many rules."
While thinking about it, Wuxian Luoqu's eyes were full of resentment.
He is a genius with victorious battles, but it is shameful to have a big somersault here today.
"Xuanyu Fairy Clan..."
"If you can run, the monk can't run the temple."
"I will definitely come back, I must take revenge!"
Wuxian Luoqu fleeing quickly, clenched his fists, gritted his teeth and said.
But the next moment.
A voice that made him utterly dispelled came from the front!
——"Vengeance? Sorry, you will never have that chance!"

chapters.title: Chapter 916: The death of Luoqu Wuxian
paragraphs: "It's you!!"
"how is this possible!"
Luo Qu Wuxian looked forward, shaking all over.
I saw a man standing in the air in front of his escape route, and it was Su Lang who beat him to the ground!
"You, you, you, how could you be here!?"
"You are not entangled by the rules of poison, and you can rush to my front so quickly!?"
Wuxian Luo Qu yelled in disbelief, and his body couldn't stop backing away, his staggering appearance, embarrassed like a panicked donkey.
"Is it difficult to deal with the mere rules of poison?"
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, "Stop talking nonsense, Luoqu Wuxian, your death date is here."
"Do not!"
"You can't kill me, you can't kill me!"
The immortal Luo Quwu roared lily, and immediately turned and fled in the other direction.
Su Lang didn't have the thought of a cat playing with a mouse, stretched out his hand, Luoqu Wuxian was immediately imprisoned by the power of space!
"Go away!"
Luoqu Wuxian let out a hoarse roar, the dark rules on his body burst out violently, trying to break away from the power of space imprisonment.
unfortunately.
No matter how hard he struggles, it will not help!
"No, don't kill me!"
"I am a genius of the Luoyou Emperor Clan, and I am highly valued by Emperor Wu!"
"If you dare to kill me, you will be chased by Lord Luo Youwu!
"If you let me go, I will plead for the Xuanyuxian clan after I go back, and ask Lord Luo Youwu to let go of the Xuanyuxian clan and Chu Xiaobei!"
After discovering that he could not break free, Wuxian Luoqu's expression immediately changed and moved out of the background of Emperor Luoyou.
"Ha ha!"
"Since I chose to help the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, and killed Jieming and Xiaya Wuxian, don't I know your background?"
"I might as well tell you this dying person, the Six Dao Immortals are just lambs for sword sacrifices, and what I really want to cut is the Emperor Luoyou!"
Su Lang looked down at Luo Qu Wuxian condescendingly, with a slight sarcasm on his face.
"Zhan...Zhan Luo You Emperor Clan!"
Wuxian Luo Qu's eyes widened in disbelief.
Since his birth, he has never heard such arrogant words.
The Luoyou Emperor Clan is a powerful emperor-level force with a history of six million years, an everlasting and powerful dynasty of warriors, and one of the peak overlords of the Canglan Continent.
There are not only emperor-level warriors in the clan, but also a large number of martial arts powerhouses!
Even other Wudi forces did not dare to say such things as Zhanluoyoudi!
But now, a mere Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal, dare to speak so boldly!
"Hahahaha!"
Wuxian Luoqu couldn't help but mockingly said, "Zhan Luoyou Emperor Clan, I think you are a mad and stupid person, I am afraid that it is not because of your cultivation that you have become crazy!"
"An ant's vision, that's it."
Su Lang shook his head disdainfully, and immediately raised his right hand with a light wave.
An invisible and intangible death rule fell on Wuxian Luoqu.
"The rule of death!"
"My life, no--!
Luoqu Wuxian let out the last miserable howl, and immediately lost his breath.

"Ding! You get the soul of high-level martial arts*1, the guide of space*1, the regular fairy crystal*1, the middle-level fairy tool Changye Moyu clothing*1, the best fairy jade*9834586 top-grade fairy jade*16842232... .Xian-level refining material...Holy refining material..."
"There are so many fairy jade!"
"Moreover, it can still be called Luoqu, and its status should not be low in the Luoyou emperor clan."
Su Lang pointedly cut off Wuxian Luo Qu's head directly, "This is a good gift."
Immediately after.
Su Lang twisted Wuxian Luoqu's head and returned to the outside of Chaoshan City.
"Master Su!"
Xuan Ao Wuxian and others greeted him.
Looking at Su Lang's hand, the head of the Qu Wuxian, could not help showing awe and admiration.
After Su Lang went back and forth, it took more than a dozen breaths.
In such a short period of time, he chased up and killed a Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal, carrying his head and turning back, which is simply astounding.
Simultaneously.
The warriors of the six immortal races in the city were almost scared to pee.
The Eight Tribulations Martial Immortal, Laya Wuxian, is dead, and now the real Luoyou Emperor Clan is also dead!
Their Six Dao Immortal Clan is completely finished.
Even if Su Lang didn't kill them, Emperor Luoyou would kill them in rage!

chapters.title: Chapter 917: Upgrade clone dispatch
paragraphs: "Riding on the defensive formation can resist for a moment, let's run away!"
Liu Bei and other three Wuxians rushed to the teleportation formation, trying to abandon the city and escape.
but.
Contact Qu Wuxian can't escape, let alone the three of them.
With one thought of Su Lang, the defense formation method directly changed hands, and another thought, the teleportation formation in Winding Mountain City instantly became invalid.
"Start the formation quickly!"
"What's the matter, the formation cannot be activated!"
"I can't control the formation, how is this possible!?"
The three of Wuxian Liupi stood on the teleportation formation, cold sweat broke out on their foreheads, and their faces were covered with anxiety and despair.
next moment.
"Where do you want to go?"
Su Lang's figure appeared in front of the three of them, with their hands behind their backs, with a relaxed and comfortable look.
"what--!!"
The three of Wuxian Liupi were frightened like thunder, shaking as if they were sifting chaff.
At this moment, the cold sweat was gone, the anxiety was gone, everyone was left with despair.
"huh huh huh huh."
Su Lang showed a glamorous smile, "Liu Ming Wuxian and the others are waiting for you underground. After enjoying the pain, go find them below."
After speaking, Su Lang did not wait for the three of Wuxian Liubei to beg for mercy, but directly abandoned the power of the rules and tortured them.
"No, no, it hurts!
"Please forgive us, we are willing to be your dog!"
"Ah, please, please go around us!"
Under the instinct to survive, they began to beg for mercy.
But to no avail, instead of reducing the power of the raging rules, it is more and more violent.
Shortly after.
Liupi Wuxian and others' begging for mercy became a begging for death.
I hope that Su Lang can give them a happy way to die.
But this is obviously a delusion!
"Enjoy it."
Su Lang smiled coldly, turned and left the teleportation formation.
He ordered Xuan Ao to suppress the Six Dao Immortal Clan warriors in the city and leave everything to Xuan Ao.
Anyway, the Wuxians of the Six Dao Immortal Clan have been wiped out, and the Immortal Clan has been misnamed.
With the power of the Three Tribulations Martial Immortal, Xuan Ao could completely sweep the entire Six Dao Immortal Clan.
The conquest of the Six Dao Immortal Clan, for Su Lang, has ended here, and the six Dao Immortal Clan that survives in name only needs to be handed over to the Xuanyu Immortal Clan.
The enemy Su Lang had to face was no longer the Six Dao Immortal Clan, but the Luoyou Emperor Clan!
The death of Luoqu Wuxian and others must have been known by the Luoyou Emperor.
The revenge of Emperor Luoyou will soon come.
"Emperor Luo Youwu probably won't end up personally so soon."
"Perhaps, he will send the real quasi emperor to kill me.
Su Lang sat in a quiet room prepared by Xuan Ao, and the corners of his mouth raised slightly, "If this is the case, I would like to come soon. I am very short of money."
After a while.
Su Lang's gaze fell on the fund balance in the mysterious black space.
The previous balance of over 90 million has become 116 million of the best immortal jade!

chapters.title: Chapter 918: Spirit, the realm of emptiness!
paragraphs: "Ding! The amount of funds is too large, and the current unit has been changed to ‘Xiacheng Xianyuan’!"
"Ding! Consumption of 10,000 lower multipliers, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 31, and the number of clones is +1!"
The system prompts Su Lang for a moment.
"It turns out that there is a currency unit on top of the best immortal jade, called Xiacheng Xianyuan!"
"Furthermore, according to the system prompts, it can be seen that the exchange ratio between the best Xianyu and the Xianyuan Xianyuan is actually 10000:1!"
"In this way, this Xianyuan Xianyuan is a bit interesting!"
While thinking about it, Su Lang took out a piece of the best immortal jade from the storage space, and then took out an inferior immortal source from the "balance".
It is not so much one, as one.
Xiacheng Xianyuan is a completely transparent bead, giving a very pure and clean feeling.
Comparing the best immortal jade with the Xiancheng Xianyuan, Su Lang quickly discovered the extraordinary of the latter.
The best fairy jade is actually an upgraded version of the spirit jade. Although there is a fairy character, the energy contained in it is still aura.
However, Xianyuan is different!
This is a higher level of energy than aura, and it is more pure and easier to absorb!
"However, although it is higher than the spiritual energy, it has not been elevated to another level."

Su Lang played with the Xianyuan Xianyuan in his hands, "This kind of thing should be the essence extracted from the best immortal jade, and the one who can refine the Xianyuan Xianyuan should be at least Emperor Wu!
Perhaps, Xianyu could no longer satisfy Emperor Wu's cultivation, but he couldn't find better cultivation resources, so he refined this kind of inferior source of immortality.
There is a lower source of immortality, and there should be a superior source of immortality. I don't know what the exchange ratio between the two will be. "
While thinking about it, Su Lang deposited the subordinate Xianyuan into the system balance.
And at this moment.
Su Lang suddenly changed his expression and turned his gaze to the cultivator in the mysterious black space.
At this time, the villain is full of golden light.
The halo behind his head was completely golden!
"Mental power is fully restored, and it has reached the peak level of the Sunshine level!"
Su Lang showed joy in his eyes, which meant that his spiritual realm could advance to a higher level.
"System, break through the spiritual realm!"
Su Lang gave an order, and a drastic change suddenly occurred in his mind!
I saw that the golden sun that was suspended high in the sky, surrounded by a halo, suddenly burst into a terrifying light!
The halo covering the sun shattered instantly.
Its fragments splashed around, then turned into nothingness, and merged into the world of consciousness!
The golden sun that lost the shackles of the halo did not scurry around, but trembled, and then... split...
It really cracked, cracked a super big hole.
Not only that, but the second and third cracks soon appeared!
A brighter golden light was ejected from the cracks, and a beam of light directly penetrated the edge of the current sea of consciousness, dispelling the unknown darkness!
Immediately after.
More and more cracks.
The whole sun, like she was molting, got rid of the old shell and ushered in a new life.
In Su Lang's senses, this process seemed to last a long time, but it seemed only a moment later.
The outer shell on the surface of the sun finally disappeared completely, revealing a bright core that could not be seen directly!
It seemed to be a real sun, shining on Su Lang's entire world of consciousness and dispelling all darkness.
And its light seems to be able to turn, the whole world of knowledge of the sea, there is no shadow!
Su Lang's knowledge of the sea, completely and thoroughly, is completely presented before his eyes!
The whole sea of consciousness seems to be transformed into a bright world, a bright sun in the sky shines on all things, and the earth is covered!
The phantom of the fire of the more than one hundred thousand souls has been irradiated with bright light, and there is actually a solid trend!
at the same time.
All the warriors who dedicated their souls to Su Lang felt warm.
Some warriors who are cultivating spiritual power feel that their cultivation speed has become faster.
This immediately aroused the joy of countless people.
"Konni...Is this the realm of "Konni"?"
"Nirvana with the sun will form the true soul sun, shining on the whole sea of consciousness!"
"And my sea of consciousness seems to be transformed into an illusory world. This is really Nirvana, the beginning of a new realm!!"
Su Langnei looked at the sea of consciousness, and there was an unconcealable surprise on his face!

paragraphs: At this moment.
Nirvana of the Sea of Consciousness has become the prototype of an illusory world!
This also reminded Su Lang of the upcoming Wuxian Inner Realm, and even the Wudi-level life universe.
"One side of the illusory world, one side of the universe of life."
"I don't know what is the relationship between the two."
Su Lang has not yet practiced the emperor level exercises, so he doesn't know much about the cultivation of Emperor Wu level yet.
He didn't panic either.
Anyway, even the immortal level has not broken through yet!
The top priority is to break through the Wuxian level and create a ten-square inner boundary.
Su Lang moved his attention away from the sea of consciousness, and then began to sort out the various materials in the storage space.
Moreover, during this time, the exchange shops in the White Moon Emperor City also harvested a large amount of high-level materials.
Su Lang took them all from the clone.
The purpose of sorting out the materials is to see if the materials for refining "super humanoid weapons" are enough, but to prepare the materials for the emperor rank formation.
Su Lang's current method of dealing with Emperor Wu is just ‘single thoughts.’
'Swallowing clones' is also a hole card, but Su Lang is not yet sure whether swallowing thirty clones can reach the emperor rank.
He estimated it would not work.
The gap between Emperor Zhun and Emperor Wu was really too big.
Swallowing thirty clones, it may be infinitely close to Emperor Wu's rank, but it is impossible to cross the sky and reach the other shore representing the Emperor's rank.
With some careful thoughts.
Su Lang synthesized most of the materials in the storage space into imperial-level array materials, and piled up a huge mountain.
"Almost a dozen five elements can be arranged with these materials, and the quantity is completely sufficient."
"However, the combined formation of Wuxingtian focuses on defense, and I have to engage in some battle-type imperial formations."
Thinking like this, Su Lang used Perfect Possession, and his consciousness descended on the clone in the Red Lotus Emperor City.
The avatar sitting on the ground opened his eyes.
On the opposite side, Honglian Wudi Ni Qianzhou was still burning that set of emperor-level exercises, completely obsessed with the exercises.
"Hehe."
"Wake him up now, I guess he will be very upset."
Su Lang smiled secretly in his heart, the corner of his mouth twitched, and he reached out and patted Emperor Wulian on the shoulder.
"Who!?"
Emperor Wulian broke out in an instant!
Those eyes ejected terrifying flames, seeming to burn the world.
However, after a short while, the anger in Ni Qianzhou's eyes was forcibly suppressed, and a smile was squeezed out of his face.
"Oh, sorry."
Ni Qianzhou said with an apologetic face, "I'm too absorbed, please forgive me, Emperor Lang."
If other people dare to disturb him in this way, just burn it to ashes.
But Su Lang did not dare to offend him.
He Ni Qianzhou still owes Su Lang a great favor.
"Aha."
"I rushed to interrupt Emperor Wu Lian because I wanted to ask some questions."
Su Lang said with a smile on his face, "I don't know which emperor clan in Canglan Continent is best at formations, I want to learn some offensive emperor-level formations.
"It turns out that Emperor Lang is still an array mage?"
Ni Qianzhou's face was surprised, and then his face was embarrassed, "Emperor-level formations are regarded as treasures by anyone, and they are afraid they won't teach Langdi."
"Haha."
"Honglian Wudi just say it."
Su Lang chuckled, "What I have is a way for them to give me the emperor rank formation."
"Uh, too!"
Ni Qianzhou suddenly remembered that Su Lang was willing to exchange even the emperor-level exercises.
If you want some emperor rank formations, as long as you come up with enough chips, those emperors are still willing to trade.
Thought of this.
Ni Qianzhou's eyes lit up again: "My three imperial formations are arranged by the famous Shang Feizi master!
If Emperor Lang wants an emperor rank formation, maybe he can go and see it? "
"It's true."
"I have already seen your formation."
Su Lang smiled, "Although I can't see through Guicheng's formation, I can also see that it is a defensive formation. I want an offensive formation."
"Oh!"
"That's it."
Ni Qianzhou nodded, and then said, "If you want an offensive formation, you can go to Qingyou Emperor Realm."
"Qingyou Emperor Realm?"
Su Lang looked surprised, "That emperor-level alliance force that has four Wudi sitting in town?"

chapters.title: Chapter 920: Eighteen imperial formations
paragraphs: "Not bad."
"It's there."
"The Qingyou Emperor Realm is almost the force in Canglan Continent that is best at formation."
"Furthermore, the four martial emperors of the Qingyou Emperor Realm are all warm-tempered, approachable and hospitable."
Ni Qianzhou said with a smile on his face, "The Emperor Lang already has the skills of formations. Going to the Qingyou Emperor Realm, there is a high probability that he can trade what he needs."
"Thank you Honglian Wudi for your guidance."
Su Lang nodded and asked, "How much do you know about Emperor Luoyou Wu?"
"Emperor Luoyou Wu?"
"The Emperor Luoyou Clan near the north?"
Ni Qianzhou didn't know why Su Lang asked Emperor Luo Youwu, but he didn't care much.
After pondering for a moment, he said, "Emperor Luoyou Wu has become an emperor with a dark avenue. He is better than me, but he probably hasn't reached the rank of Rank 4 Wudi yet."
"That's it."
Su Lang smiled, and immediately closed his eyes, releasing his perfect possession.
Ni Qianzhou looked at Su Lang's clone with some envy.
He could see that the Emperor Wu from the'Mainland Fragment' was not only not poor, but dying rich.
At the beginning, he asked Shang Feizi to help him arrange three emperor rank formations, which almost consumed all his savings.
As for Emperor Lang, not only could he exchange the emperor rank technique, he had to go to the Qingyou Emperor Realm to exchange the imperial rank formation technique!
After a while of envy.
Ni Qianzhou continued to study and record the emperor-level exercises.
And Su Lang.
He possessed a clone of Baiyue Emperor City, went to the teleportation hall, and reached the main city of Qingyou Emperor Realm through the teleportation array.
The main city is called Qingyou City.
It is not an imperial city, but it is bigger than the imperial city, even Baiyue imperial city can't compare with it.
After all, this is a city jointly ruled by the four Emperor Wu!
Su Lang did not visit the master of the Qingyou Emperor Realm and exchange the emperor rank formation as Ni Qianzhou thought.
exchange?
Exchange a fur.
Just look at it and learn it!
Su Lang strolled around the city happily and learned all the formations here.
I have to say that the Qingyou Emperor Realm is indeed an emperor-level force that is good at formations!
This Qingyou city alone has 18 emperor rank formations! Six hundred and forty fairy-level formations!
There are fifteen defensive formations and three offensive formations in the imperial formations.
Each of these formations has its own characteristics, and it can be seen at a glance that they are from different formation mages.
The attributes of the formation are relatively common, namely wood, water, soil, and wind.
The imperial formations of each attribute are linked to each other, supplemented by a large number of immortal formations to form a combined formation.

Although this array is not as complete as the Five Elements United Imperial Array, its size is much larger than that of the Five Elements United Imperial Array in the Baiyue Emperor City, and its defense power is also very high.
The attacking array rule made Su Lang's eyes brightened.
The three attacking imperial formations are actually lightning, gold and space attributes!
Every emperor-level formation has an offensive ability of the Three Tribulations Emperor Wudi level.
As long as there is enough energy, a formation can be compared to a three-rank martial emperor!

In particular, the emperor-level formation of the space system possesses extremely powerful trapping and killing capabilities, like Emperor Red Lotus and his ilk. Once trapped, they will lose half their lives if they don't die.
However, the formation masters of the Qingyou Emperor Realm obviously have limited attainments. Although there are these three attacking formations, they cannot be united.
"I didn't expect the harvest to be so rich!"
"Those defensive formations, I can take them back to strengthen the Five Elements Heaven!"
"These three offensive formations, you can think of ways to unite them to create a stronger attack formation!"
"What the Qingyou Emperor Realm can't do can be done easily with me. Who gave me the formation skills of the Primordial Realm?"
Su Lang touched his chin, his eyes gleamed, and his heart felt happy.
Immediately after.
Su Lang sent many avatars again, and opened an exchange shop in this Qingyou City.
Everything is in accordance with the specifications of the shop in Baiyue Emperor City.
Originally, Su Lang intended to slip away after learning the formation technique secretly.
But I didn't expect that there were so many emperor rank formations, and more and more materials were needed.
And Qingyou City is bigger than Baiyue Emperor City, and it is also a good untapped market, so you can't just let it go!
In addition, in addition to the material exchange business, Su Lang also launched the material sales business.
The main thing is to prepare for the formation energy. The imperial formation requires too much energy, and it is difficult for Su Lang to support it.

The imperial formations of each attribute are linked to each other, supplemented by a large number of immortal formations to form a combined formation.

Although this array is not as complete as the Five Elements United Imperial Array, its size is much larger than that of the Five Elements United Imperial Array in the Baiyue Emperor City, and its defense power is also very high.
The attacking array rule made Su Lang's eyes brightened.
The three attacking imperial formations are actually lightning, gold and space attributes!
Every emperor-level formation has an offensive ability of the Three Tribulations Emperor Wudi level.
As long as there is enough energy, a formation can be compared to a three-rank martial emperor!
In particular, the emperor-level formation of the space system possesses extremely powerful trapping and killing capabilities, like Emperor Red Lotus and his ilk.
Once trapped, they will lose half their lives if they don't die.
However, the formation masters of the Qingyou Emperor Realm obviously have limited attainments.
Although there are these three attacking formations, they cannot be united.
"I didn't expect the harvest to be so rich!"
"Those defensive formations, I can take them back to strengthen the Five Elements Heaven!"
"These three offensive formations, you can think of ways to unite them to create a stronger attack formation!"
"What the Qingyou Emperor Realm can't do can be done easily with me.
Who gave me the formation skills of the Primordial Realm?"
Su Lang touched his chin, his eyes gleamed, and his heart felt happy.
Immediately after.
Su Lang sent many avatars again, and opened an exchange shop in this Qingyou City.
Everything is in accordance with the specifications of the shop in Baiyue Emperor City.
Originally, Su Lang intended to slip away after learning the formation technique secretly.
But I didn't expect that there were so many emperor rank formations, and more and more materials were needed.
And Qingyou City is bigger than Baiyue Emperor City, and it is also a good untapped market, so you can't just let it go!
In addition, in addition to the material exchange business, Su Lang also launched the material sales business.
The main thing is to prepare for the formation energy.
The imperial formation requires too much energy, and it is difficult for Su Lang to support it.

chapters.title: Chapter 921: The whole city bows down
paragraphs: Su Lang gave full authority to the avatar to open the shop.
These avatars have high intelligence and experience in opening a shop. Opening a ‘Exchange House Franchise Shop’ is a trivial matter.
After leaving the avatar incarnation to open the shop.
Su Lang's consciousness returned to the deity in Chaoshan City.
It just so happened that Xuan'ao Wuxian had already cleaned up the Six Dao Xian Clan warriors in the whole mountain-winding city, and was outside the door, waiting for Su Lang to meet him.
"come in."
Su Lang said lightly.
"Master Langdi!"

Xuan Ao Wuxian entered the quiet room, knelt in front of Su Lang, and said with some excitement, "Should we strike while the iron is hot, pursue the victory and destroy the Six Dao Immortals in one fell swoop?"
He was fed up with the shame brought by the Six Dao Immortals.
At this moment, as soon as he turned over, he immediately wanted to strangle the Six Dao Immortals to death.
"Do not!"
"The Six Dao Immortal Clan has a huge area, and with many martial sage forces, it is even greater."
"Liu Bei, Liu Ming and other Wuxians have all died, the people of the Liu Dao Xian Clan must have known it, maybe they have already begun to flee at this time."
"We don't know how or where they flee, so no matter how fast they move, they cannot be wiped out in an instant."
"Therefore, it will take a long time to completely eliminate the Six Dao Immortal Clan, so there is no need to rush for a while."
"Furthermore, once Luoqu Wuxian dies, Emperor Luoyou will definitely send someone over. This time he is a real strong man!"
"At this moment, it's not a good time to deal with the Six Dao Immortals."
"When I deal with Emperor Luoyou, where can the Liudao Immortal Clan go there?"
Su Lang shook his head and analyzed, Xuan Ao Wuxian suddenly lowered his head in shame.
"Go ahead."
"Assemble everyone, we will return to Xuanyu Fairy City."
"In addition, in order to prevent Emperor Luoyou from going crazy, send people to massacre the Xuanyuxian martial artists.
You contact Wuxian Xuanyue and ask him to summon all the warriors of the clan, erect walls to clear the land, and enter Xuanyuxian City for refuge. "
Su Lang gave the order at once, and he already had a lot of experience after going through the large-scale war with the Slaughter Sky Tower.
In order to concentrate on dealing with Emperor Luoyou Wu, the rear area must be protected first.
"Yes!"
Xuan Ao Wuxian respectfully took his life, and then retreated.
Not long.
Chu Xiaobei and others all gathered beside Su Lang.
"Space rules!"
With a thought in Su Lang, a large number of spatial grids emerged, forming a black hole channel.
"let's go!"
With a big wave of his hand, Su Lang led Chu Xiaobei, Xuan Ao, Yu Hu and others to leave the deadly mountain-winding city.
at the same time.
Xuanyu Fairy City.
A spatial channel appeared in the air.
Countless Xuanyu fairy clan warriors looked up and suddenly found the figures of Su Lang and others.
As a result, the entire Xuanyu Fairy City was like a big pot, boiling instantly!
"The mysterious emperor is back!"
"Master Chu Xiaobei, they are all back!"
"Master Xuan'ao and Master Yu Hu are back too, great!"
"We have won, we have completely defeated the Six Dao Immortals, hahahaha!"
"All of this is the credit of the adults from the mysterious emperor. If it weren't for him, our Xuanyu Fairy Clan would be finished sooner or later!"
"I will wait and thank this lord, he is the lifesaver of our Xuanyu Fairy Clan!"
In less than a day, he conquered the lost ground of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan.
He also killed all the martial immortals of the Six Dao Immortal Clan, leaving them in name only. In retrospect, it was like a dream.
Some of the warriors in Xuanyu Fairy City were dumbfounded, dumbfounded, some shouted loudly, and some talked.
But more, it is a warrior who is so excited that he is speechless!
Wuxian Xuanyue, who had heard the news, knelt in the void a long way away, bowing to Su Lang three times and nine times, with tears on his face.
God knows how much pressure he endured after letting Chu Xiaobei go.
Whether it was from the Luoyou Emperor clan, from the Liudaoxian clan, or from the opposition within the clan, he couldn't breathe.
At this moment.
Although Emperor Luoyou still overlooked the Xuanyu Immortal Clan from above, the urgent need of the Six Dao Immortal Clan has been resolved.
Two of the three major worries were gone, and Xuanyu Wuxian finally breathed a sigh of relief!
Looking at the Xuanyu Fairy City surrendered at his feet, Su Lang smiled faintly.

chapters.title: Chapter 922: Not enough words
paragraphs: "Six Dao Immortal Clan has been destroyed."
"But the Emperor Luoyou is still weighing on everyone."
"Next, with the Xuanyu Immortal Clan's desire for Taoism and the hatred towards Luo You, I will go to the Luoyou Emperor Clan and kill Emperor Luoyou Wu!"
Su Lang threw out his goal and left everyone's sight with a bright smile.
"Kill Emperor Luo Youwu!!"
"Oh my God, you want to kill Emperor Luo Youwu!"
"The mysterious lord from the imperial clan is actually a real Wudi!"
"I'm waiting for Emperor Wu to take pity, revenge for us, and seek for the truth for us. It's really an unprecedented opportunity!"
Su Lang is gone, but Xuanyu Fairy City is still boiling.
The other side.
Su Lang received Xuan Yue Wuxian, accepted his kneeling again, and let him go to work with Xuan Ao Wuxian.
By Su Lang's side, Chu Xiaobei was left alone.
"Su Lang."
"Is it really sure?"
The next step was to face the Luoyou Emperor. Even if Chu Xiaobei had liked Su Lang's constant miracles, she was still a little worried.
Without him, the Emperor Clan is really terrifying.
An emperor has suppressed a land for six to seven million years!
Over such a long period of time, the creatures have reproduced from generation to generation. I don't know how many creatures live and die like ants.
But the imperial clan is still immortal!
That long-lasting sense of history has made countless creatures dare not offend.
The concept of imperial invincibility was engraved in the minds of most people in Canglan Continent.
Chu Xiaobei believed that Su Lang had the ability to kill Emperor Wu, and he was amazed by it.
But when things came, she couldn't help but worry a little.
"Do not worry."
"I will definitely kill Emperor Wuyou Luo."
"Even if there is an accident and I can't kill him, nothing will happen to me."
Su Lang patted Chu Xiaobei on the head, gently relieved.
"Then, you must pay attention to safety."
Chu Xiaobei nodded earnestly, like a little daughter-in-law sending her husband out.
"I will."
Su Lang smiled brilliantly.
Next.
Su Lang continued to prepare for the war.
The first is to set up an emperor-level defensive formation for Xuanyu Fairy City.
Then all the nearly 3 billion treasure hunting flying flying gliders were released to act as scouts to ensure the safety of the rear.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang began to study the formation.
He wants to combine the lightning, gold, and space formations newly obtained from Qingyou City to create a more terrifying emperor-level formation.
It didn't take much time to combine several emperor-level formations with Su Lang's formation skills in the Primordial Realm.
after an hour.
The brand-new offensive combined imperial formation appeared in Su Lang's mind.
This formation was named the "Three Kills Prison Emperor Formation" by Su Lang. It was a very powerful formation.
Its power has reached the real Rank 4 Wudi level, higher than the level of the Five Elements United Emperor Formation!
"According to Emperor Wulian's statement."
"Emperor Luo You Wu hasn't broken through to Rank 4, and he is currently Emperor Wu of Rank 3."
"This set of Three Kills Prison Emperor Formation is enough, and if one set is not enough, I will give him two sets!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, giving a hint of playfulness.
And at this moment.
His expression changed suddenly.
"come yet!?"
Su Lang closed his eyes, using perception sharing, and a scene appeared before his eyes.
I saw a large amount of light emitting from a teleportation formation on the outskirts of Xuanyu Fairy City.
An old man covered in black robe walked out of the teleportation formation, rose up into the sky, and came towards Xuanyu Immortal City.
He had the racial characteristics of the Luoyou Emperor Clan, and he could tell at a glance that he was a member of the Luoyou Emperor Clan.
"Sure enough, it is the quasi emperor."
"It seems that Emperor Luo Youwu still didn't realize what kind of opponent he was facing."
"I want to think about it. The Xuanyu Immortal Clan is originally a force under the Luoyou Emperor Clan, and other Wudi forces will not rush in."

"So, in the eyes of Emperor Luoyou Wu, it is basically impossible for the Xuanyu Immortal Clan to be supported by the emperor. Since it is not an emperor, it is more than enough to send a quasi emperor."
"But is it more than enough, haha!"
Su Lang thought about it, and then sneered, waiting for the quasi emperor to come and die.
Just then.
The black robe quasi-emperor had already arrived not far from Xuanyu Immortal City.
